description: Robert White, Jr. is a proud 5th generation Washingtonian, growing up in the Petworth neighborhood. He graduated from Archbishop Carroll High School in Washington, D.C. and earned degrees in Philosophy and Political Science from St. Mary’s College of Maryland. He completed additional studies at Oxford University in England and in The Gambia, West Africa. Robert earned his law degree from the American University Washington College of Law
